status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iranian drones struck a Komala Kurdish opposition base on the outskirts of Erbil, and a separate explosion hit the same area, while a malfunction caused a blast at a Popular Mobilization Forces ammunition depot that injured five people. A scrap collector was shot dead near a PMF site in Baghdad, and Turkish foreign minister praised Iraqi premier's vision for bilateral ties in Baghdad. These incidents show continued attacks on Iranian-linked opposition groups and PMF facilities alongside diplomatic engagement. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iranske droner rammet en Komala-kurdisk opposisjonsbase på utkanten av Erbil, og en separat eksplosjon traff samme område, mens en feil i driften forårsaket en eksplosjon på et ammunisjonsdepot til Popular Mobilization Forces som såret fem personer. En skrapesamler ble skutt og drept nær et PMF-anlegg i Bagdad, og den tyrkiske utenriksministeren roste Iraks statsminister for hans visjon om bilaterale bånd i Bagdad. Disse hendelsene viser fortsatte angrep på iransk-tilknyttede opposisjonsgrupper og PMF-anlegg samtidig som det foregår diplomatisk engasjement. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
